name: Alert
summary: A callout with an icon, a title and a body; its tone is said in words.
rungReason: A <div> with a paragraph title; role="status" or role="alert" is added only when it's injected after load.

attributes.role: status or alert, only when injected

a11y.role: none when static; status (polite) or alert (assertive, errors only) when injected
a11y.name: n/a
a11y.description: The tone word (visually hidden) starts the title, so the tone is never colour or icon alone

keyboard.action: Passes over it: nothing here takes focus

focus.indicator: Not focusable; links inside it have their own

rules: Not an <aside>: inside <main> it maps to a complementary landmark (HTML-AAM), one per callout, and ARIA in HTML doesn't allow role=status or alert on it (checked 2026-10-24)
A live region announces changes, not its first render: render the status container empty, then fill it; role=alert announces on insertion
contrast: The chrome ring becomes one strong line
forcedColors: Canvas with a CanvasText border; the icon and word carry the tone
